title: San Francisco: Malone's Mobster Hideout Escape Room at PIER 39
includes: Private group experience — no strangers added to your group
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the only escape rooms on PIER 39 at The Flyer Thrill Zone. Step into Malone's Mobster Hideout — a fully immersive Prohibition-era escape adventure set in San Francisco's gangster underworld. Work with your team to uncover hidden clues, crack the codes, and outsmart the mob before time runs out. Located above the Hard Rock Cafe with sweeping views of the Bay, this is a uniquely San Francisco thrill you won't find anywhere else on the waterfront. Private groups only — it's just you and your crew against the clock.
